headline: Second cyberattack wave hits supermarket fridges across Europe
summary: A second wave of cyberattacks in about a month remotely altered temperature settings on supermarket refrigeration systems across multiple European countries, spoiling food, echoing an earlier hack of French shops. One outlet reports stores in at least seven countries saw temperatures soar overnight to as high as 50C (122F).
